# QA Review: Carter Digitals Website Screenshot

## Dimension Ratings (1-10)

1. **Visual quality and polish: 8/10**
   - Professional dark theme with consistent styling
   - Clean overall presentation with no obvious visual glitches
   - Minor concern: The "Make Money" text has a slight glow effect that looks slightly inconsistent with the rest of the typography
   - Navigation items appear well-aligned and properly spaced

2. **Color consistency and contrast: 7/10**
   - Good contrast between dark background and light text
   - Gold/yellow accent color is used consistently for buttons and highlights
   - The "Make Money" text has slightly lower contrast than other elements due to its glow effect
   - White text on dark background maintains good readability
   - The cookie consent banner has good contrast

3. **Typography hierarchy: 8/10**
   - Clear hierarchy with large heading, medium subheading, and body text
   - Font choices appear professional and appropriate for a digital agency
   - Heading sizes create good visual flow
   - "Make Money" text stands out with different styling (gold color and glow)
   - Stat cards use consistent typography

4. **Layout and spacing: 8/10**
   - Well-balanced layout with proper alignment
   - Good spacing between sections and elements
   - Consistent padding and margins throughout
   - The three stat cards at the bottom are evenly spaced and aligned
   - Navigation items have appropriate spacing

5. **Overall impression: 8/10**
   - Professional and modern appearance
   - Clear value proposition ("We Build Websites That Make Money")
   - Good use of social proof elements (B-BBEE certification, location, tech stack)
   - The dark theme with gold accents creates a premium feel

## Specific Issues/Notes:
- The "Make Money" text has a glow effect that appears slightly inconsistent with the rest of the design
- The chat widget in the bottom right corner appears to be partially cut off or overlapping with the cookie banner
- The cookie consent banner has a "Decline" button that's less prominent than the "Accept" button (could be intentional but worth noting)
- The navigation menu items have inconsistent spacing (some appear closer together than others)
- The "Get a Quote" button in the top right corner has a different style than the "Get a Free Quote" button below (different text and arrow styling)
- The scroll indicator dots on the right side appear to be partially cut off
- The "Chat with Carter AI" text in the bottom right is very small and difficult to read

## Recommendations:
- Standardize button styles throughout the site
- Ensure all elements are fully visible and not overlapping
- Consider adjusting the glow effect on "Make Money" for better consistency
- Verify that all interactive elements are properly sized and accessible
- Check that all text is legible at various screen sizes (responsive testing)
